description: Representative schema: aten::_fake_quantize_per_tensor_affine_cachemask_tensor_qparams(Tensor self, Tensor scale, Tensor zero_point, Tensor fake_quant_enabled, int quant_min, int quant_max) -> (Tensor output, Tensor mask).
